launcherSteps.title: Shortcut properties
launcherSteps.text: Right-click the shortcut you use to start Crossout and open Properties.

launcherSteps.title: Target field
launcherSteps.text: At the very end of the line, add a space and then the key.

launcherSteps.title: Play a battle
launcherSteps.text: Start the game with that shortcut and play until the victory or defeat screen. Leaving early does not save the record.

launcherSteps.title: Find the file
launcherSteps.text: combat.log appears in C:/Users/{Username}/AppData/Local/Targem/Crossout/logs/{DATE}. Use the file from the newest folder.

steamSteps.title: Open properties
steamSteps.text: In the Steam library, right-click Crossout and choose Properties.

steamSteps.title: Launch options
steamSteps.text: Paste the key into Launch Options. Keep any options that are already there and add this one after a space.

steamSteps.title: Play a battle
steamSteps.text: Close the properties and start the game from Steam. Finish the battle, otherwise the file will not appear.

steamSteps.title: Find the file
steamSteps.text: combat.log appears in C:/Users/{Username}/AppData/Local/Targem/Crossout/logs/{DATE}. Use the file from the newest folder.
